ops.entry: WHEN a gate or sweep reports zero or a small count DO confirm both that it discovered a non-zero set and that its pattern matches a known positive before accepting it — an empty sweep and a mis-anchored pattern both exit like cleanliness, and nobody re-runs your sweep.
ops.why: Merges old P-13 (non-zero discovery count) and P-14 (pattern matches a known positive): one situation, a zero that reads as clean, two causes. Frees P-13 for a new rule; no longer than the longer input.

ops.entry: WHEN rating a divergence a refactor introduces into a gate's output DO classify its direction against the truth — fail-open, fail-closed, or more accurate than base — before severity; confining base's own imprecision is no regression, while hiding a real defect is one at any size.
ops.why: Across three validate cycles of a gate-module split, every divergence on perturbed trees was rated by direction: no more fail-open (per-file counts), more accurate than base (per-file alias map), fail-open false negative (raw-text prefilter). That axis set the operational rating carried under P-04; no member rates it. Displaces old P-13, now absorbed into P-14.

ops.entry: WHEN a stricter lock exposes a real production site DO derive that site from the governing authority rather than exempt it — exemptions preserve the parallel source of truth the lock exists to remove.
ops.why: Form fix: the entry carried a duplicated 'O-02:' prefix inside its text. Content unchanged.

originals.original: WHEN a sweep for a defect class returns zero or a small count DO first confirm the pattern matches a known positive instance — a pattern anchored on a detail the real instances lack reports an absence indistinguishable from cleanliness, and your own sweep is the one nobody re-runs.

WHEN a change moves what a gate DISCOVERS DO require a reported non-zero discovery count before accepting its exit code — a sweep over an empty set exits 0 exactly like a clean sweep, and no fixture binds the real tree.

O-02: WHEN a stricter lock exposes a real production site DO derive that site from the governing authority rather than exempt it — exemptions preserve the parallel source of truth the lock exists to remove.
